description: This file defines a controller class 'Step3' used in the installation process of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages displaying the third step of setup, handling database configuration form submission, validation, and generating configuration files.

classes.name: Step3
classes.description: Controller class for the third step of installation, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the installation step 3 page, loads language, sets page title, gathers database driver options, and loads header and footer.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for database setup, performs validation, attempts database connection, writes configuration files, and redirects to the next step.
